answer: Think of a fingerprint that moves. Your behavior fingerprint is your typing rhythm, work hours, and task choices. Every epoch the system compares recent actions with your history; a vertex where the pattern breaks flags you for review. A comet leaves a trail, but clones repeat the same trail every time. If your fingerprint jumps, pass a live work check in 2 epochs or lose rewards for 6 epochs. A second jump slashes 50% of your stake. Running 1,000 clones means faking 1,000 habits at once, costing about 5,000 units per epoch, and like karst caves, real users differ inside.
